environment.description: Same IoT edge gateway on ECS Fargate with task role 'iot-gateway-scoped-role'. The IAM policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition with StringEquals against the ECS task metadata credential-fetched attribute '${aws:PrincipalTag/device_id}'. The principal tag is set via an STS session tag propagated from the ECS task definition's taskRoleArn which has a permission boundary (iot-device-boundary-policy) that includes a Deny statement for dynamodb:PutItem where 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' does not match '${aws:PrincipalTag/device_id}'. Additionally, Fargate tasks run with isolated PID namespaces per container (pidMode: task), and the container runs with a read-only root filesystem with CONFIG_PATH pointing to a tmpfs mount that is only writable by the init process (PID 1).
